title: This Plane Hit 4,520 Miles Per Hour After a Bomber Dropped It

scenes.text: A pilot flew a rocket plane at 4,520 miles per hour.
In 1967, Pete Knight flew the X-15 at more than six times the speed of sound.
It couldn't take off alone. A B-52 bomber carried it up and dropped it at 45,000 feet.
Then the pilot lit the rocket engine.
That's still the record for a crewed rocket plane.
A mile every 0.8 seconds, back in 1967.

description:
In 1967 the X-15 rocket plane flew at 4,520 miles per hour, dropped from a B-52 at 45,000 feet.
It's still the record for a crewed rocket plane.
Would you fly it?
